gui.vocabulary-spark.about_message:
Vocabulary Spark

Your vocabulary workspace in Minecraft.

GUI and file dialogs: TCDCommons API.
Interface architecture inspired by Better Statistics Screen.

Daily study, a local wordbook library, and TXT/JSON/SQLite import and export.
gui.vocabulary-spark.home_intro: CET4, CET6, postgraduate, IELTS and TOEFL word lists are included. Open a book to browse, or import your own.
gui.vocabulary-spark.empty_hint: Start by importing your CET4, CET6, IELTS or personal word list.
gui.vocabulary-spark.no_books: No wordbooks yet. Import a JSON, TXT or SQLite file to get started.
gui.vocabulary-spark.import_help:
File → Import wordbook
Use the current Vocabulary Spark JSON/SQLite export format.
TXT: one word or phrase per line.
Imported books are kept locally and are available next time you launch the game.
gui.vocabulary-spark.export_help:
Open a book to select it for export.
Choose TXT, JSON or SQLite. JSON/SQLite preserve the name, ID and word order; TXT contains one word per line.
Exports contain wordbook contents only, without player study records.
gui.vocabulary-spark.library_hint: CET4, CET6, postgraduate, IELTS and TOEFL word lists are included. You can also import your own. Select a book to browse or export, and switch between books using tabs.
gui.vocabulary-spark.wordbook_lookup_hin: Click a word or phrase to look it up and open its details.
gui.vocabulary-spark.search_placeholder: Enter an English word or phrase…
gui.vocabulary-spark.search_hint: Enter a word, then press Enter or Search to look it up.
gui.vocabulary-spark.search_found: Found %s. Click the word for its full entry.
gui.vocabulary-spark.search_not_found: No entry found for %s. Check the spelling and try again.
gui.vocabulary-spark.search_invalid_inpu: Enter a word or phrase of 1–200 characters.
gui.vocabulary-spark.search_connection_f: Could not connect to the dictionary service. Check your connection and try again.
gui.vocabulary-spark.pronunciation_faile: Could not load or play this pronunciation. Click to retry.
gui.vocabulary-spark.pronunciation_muted: Pronunciation is muted. Check Master and UI volume.
gui.vocabulary-spark.study_goal_hint: 1–500 words, including due reviews and new words. Changing the goal keeps completed work.
gui.vocabulary-spark.study_schedule_hint: Fuzzy / Unfamiliar: repeat today until Familiar, and review tomorrow even if you later choose Familiar today. The same rule applies during reviews. Each player and wordbook has separate progress.
gui.vocabulary-spark.study_invalid_goal: Enter a whole number from 1 to 500.
gui.vocabulary-spark.study_error: Study progress could not be loaded or saved: %s
gui.vocabulary-spark.study_start_hint: Choose a wordbook first, then set your daily goal. Your place is saved automatically.
gui.vocabulary-spark.study_nothing_due: No new words or reviews are due today.
gui.vocabulary-spark.study_complete_hint: Come back tomorrow, switch wordbooks, or increase the goal to study more new words today.
gui.vocabulary-spark.study_recall_hint: Recall the meaning and choose your familiarity, or reveal the answer first.
gui.vocabulary-spark.study_no_definition: No dictionary entry was found. You can retry or grade the word from memory.
gui.vocabulary-spark.study_lookup_failed: The dictionary is unavailable. Your study progress is still saved.
gui.vocabulary-spark.today_words_empty: No words match this view. Try another filter or clear the search.
gui.vocabulary-spark.today_words_hint: Click a word to open its dictionary entry. Browsing keeps your learning status unchanged.
